name: SSL Checker
description: Perform a TLS handshake against a host and stream the negotiated parameters, certificate chain and verification result.

hints.sni: When empty, the host name is used as SNI.
hints.versions: Empty means the default range (TLS 1.2 and above).
hints.ciphers: TLS 1.3 suites cannot be restricted by configuration.

faq.q: Why is verification reported as incomplete?
faq.a: When no local trust store is available only chain self-consistency can be checked; `verified` is then false and a warning is returned.

faq.q: What happens with an internal address?
faq.a: The egress guard blocks private, loopback and link-local addresses with `SSRF_BLOCKED`.

faq.q: Can I open several connections at once?
faq.a: No. One streaming connection per source IP is allowed at a time.
